quote: The expression of mucins (MUC5AC, MUC6, MUC2, and CD10) was assessed.
summary: CD10 is one of several mucin phenotype markers stained in gastric cancer; no specific result about MME and unrelated to UC.
MME here means morphine milligram equivalent, not the MME gene.

quote: Functional analysis of the gastrointestinal mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue revealed increased signaling via the PI3K-AKT pathway, including phosphorylation of S6 and increased cell proliferation, but also reduced apoptosis of CD20(+)CD10(+) B cells.
summary: CD10 is used only as a B cell marker in PTEN hamartoma syndrome gut tissue; the gene itself is not studied.
NEP here means nonencephalitogenic protein in an old allergic encephalitis study, not neprilysin.
NEP-F here means a non-extractable polyphenol-rich grape fraction, not neprilysin.

quote: In addition, Lpc-EV reverses Aβ-induced downregulation of the Aβ-degrading proteases Matrix metalloproteinase 2 (Mmp-2), Mmp-9, and Neprilysin (Nep), whose upregulation is also controlled by MeCP2 and Sirt1.
summary: Neprilysin is one of several amyloid-degrading proteases restored by bacterial vesicles in Alzheimer's model mice; no intestinal or UC relevance.

quote: We further screened three key NETs-related genes (PTGS2, MME and SLC2A3) and verified that they have the potential to predict periodontitis.
summary: MME was one of three NETs-related genes with predictive value for periodontitis in gingival single-cell and machine-learning analysis; not UC.

quote: Distinct subtypes of solid tumors showed different protein expression profiles, allowing for the differential diagnosis of neuroblastoma (CD56(hi)/GD2(+)/CD81(hi)), primitive neuroectodermal tumors (CD271(hi)/CD99(+)), Wilms tumors (>1 cell population), rhabdomyosarcoma (nuMYOD1(+)/numyogenin(+)), carcinomas (CD45(-)/EpCAM(+)), germ cell tumors (CD56(+)/CD45(-)/NG2(+)/CD10(+)) and eventually also hemangiopericytomas (CD45(-)/CD34(+)).
summary: CD10 is one marker in a flow cytometry panel for pediatric tumor classification; unrelated to UC.

quote: The CD10(-)CD16(low) phenotype constitute 2% of PMN in peripheral blood of SLE patients compared with 6.4% in controls, indicating a decreased release of PMN from the bone marrow in SLE.
summary: CD10 is used as a neutrophil maturity marker in lupus blood; the gene is not studied and the disease is not UC.

quote: Expression of CALLA was absent from normal stomach epithelium, adult and fetal colonic epithelium of normal histology, and colonic epithelium from patients with Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis.
summary: CALLA (CD10, MME) protein was absent in colonic epithelium of UC and Crohn's patients and normal colon, but present in the small intestine brush border.

quote: The top 10 most up-regulated genes were CSF3, MAFA, CR2, GLDC, SAA1, LBP, MME, MMP3, MME-AS1, and SAA4.
summary: MME is listed among the top upregulated genes in periodontitis gingival RNA-seq; no UC data.
Nep here means neuropathic pain after spinal cord injury, not neprilysin.

quote: Among the strongest statistical associations were loss of MAC-inhibitory protein/CD59, loss of ICAM-1/CD54, and increase in CDKN2A as a function of increasing passage, as well as increased CD10 expression with adipogenic and osteogenic capacities.
summary: CD10 is one surface marker tracked in mesenchymal stromal cell passaging; no UC relevance.

quote: They did not express hematopoietic markers (CD11b, CD19 and CD34), and lymphocyte or leukocyte antigens CD3, CD7, CD20, CD14, CD45, CCR5 (CD195), CD11b and CD10 on their surfaces.
summary: CD10 was negative on dental and adipose stem cells in a surface marker panel; no UC relevance.
MME here means morphine milligram equivalents of opioid use, not the MME gene.

quote: Several evidences have pointed at Neprilysin (NEP) as one of pulmonary RAS components.
summary: Review proposing neprilysin pathways as a therapeutic angle in COVID-19; no intestinal or UC content.

quote: Prevention of PBEF translation with an antisense oligonucleotide completely abrogates the inhibitory effects of LPS, IL-1, GM-CSF, IL-8, and TNF-alpha on neutrophil apoptosis.
summary: PBEF/NAMPT silencing restored neutrophil apoptosis and recombinant PBEF blocked it, so NAMPT prolongs neutrophil survival in inflammation and sepsis; not UC.

quote: This review summarizes these various functional aspects of Nampt and discusses its potential roles in diseases, including type 2 diabetes and cancer.
summary: Review of Nampt in NAD biology, metabolism and inflammation, focused on diabetes and cancer, without UC data.

quote: The high expression of nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase (Nampt), an enzyme involved in the nicotinamide-dependent NAD biosynthetic pathway, in cells of the immune system has led us to examine the potential relationship between NAD metabolism and inflammation.
summary: Nampt is mentioned only as motivation for studying NAD and TNF synthesis; the study tested NAD and Sirt6, not Nampt.

quote: PBEF expression is up-regulated in a variety of acute and chronic inflammatory diseases including sepsis, acute lung injury, rheumatoid arthritis, inflammatory bowel disease, and myocardial infarction and plays a key role in the persistence of inflammation through its capacity to inhibit neutrophil apoptosis.
summary: Review describing PBEF/visfatin as an NAD enzyme, cytokine and adipokine that is upregulated in inflammatory diseases including IBD.

quote: Importantly, a specific competitive inhibitor of NAMPT effectively reduced arthritis severity with comparable activity to etanercept, and decreased pro-inflammatory cytokine secretion in affected joints.
summary: A NAMPT inhibitor reduced collagen-induced arthritis severity and cytokine secretion in mice, supporting NAMPT as pro-inflammatory; not tested in colitis.

quote: This review article summarizes the research history and reported functions of this unique protein and discusses the pathophysiological significance of Nampt as an NAD biosynthetic enzyme vs. a potential inflammatory cytokine in diverse biological contexts.
summary: Review of Nampt as an NAD enzyme and extracellular cytokine across metabolism and disease, without UC data.

quote: FK866 ameliorated DSS-induced colitis and suppressed inflammation-associated tumorigenesis in mice.
summary: The NAMPT inhibitor FK866 reduced DSS colitis, colitis-associated tumours and cytokine release from IBD patient lamina propria cells, so NAMPT blockade is protective.

quote: However, during evolution they both acquired novel functions as extracellular endogenous mediators of inflammation.
summary: Review of NAMPT and NAPRT as NAD enzymes that also act as extracellular inflammatory mediators, without UC-specific data.

quote: PBEF/visfatin, another recently characterized adipocytokine, has been linked to several inflammatory disease states beyond insulin resistance, such as acute lung injury or inflammatory bowel diseases.
summary: Review of adipocytokines noting that PBEF/visfatin is linked to inflammatory states including IBD.
